description: This file contains CMake functions for processing JSON strings, including converting JSON-encoded strings into CMake strings by unescaping escape sequences and handling quoted strings.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a CMake string by removing quotes and unescaping characters.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON string reference and converts its contents to a CMake string.
